title: Energizing Malty Algerian Goat Meat Tagine
description: A hearty and flavorful Algerian dish featuring goat meat, perfect for a post-workout meal, with a malty twist and aerated texture, made in an iron teppan vessel and cut in the katsuramuki style for a unique presentation, this vegetarian-friendly option is sure to satisfy
instructions: Heat the iron teppan vessel over medium-high heat and add the olive oil to coat the bottom
Add the chopped onion to the vessel and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the vessel and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes until fragrant
Add the katsuramuki-cut goat meat to the vessel and cook until it is browned on all sides
Add the ground cumin and coriander to the vessel and stir to combine
Add the malt syrup, salt, and black pepper to the vessel and stir to combine
Add the water to the vessel and bring the mixture to a boil
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the tagine for 1 1/2 hours, or until the meat is tender and the sauce has thickened
Remove the vessel from the heat and let it cool for a few minutes before serving
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired
